entries.title: Typing in a card on iPhone or iPad gives the card more room
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, while you type in a card's reply box or a text box inside a card, the page count, your last message and the message box below the card step aside, so the card grows down to the keyboard. The box you type in keeps a little room under it, or the card's choices show under the reply. Everything comes back when the keyboard closes, and the message box keeps what you had typed.
entries.noPicture: The phone checks take the pictures of a card with the keyboard up; the desktop hero picture cannot capture the phone app.
